name: Tattoo studio

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Custom tattoo
services.story: The main story: a custom tattoo, priced by Theo from Alex's reference photos at $300 and OK'd by Sam. A $100 deposit now, the $200 rest at the desk.

services.name: Half sleeve session
services.story: A half sleeve session by the hour ($180 an hour), from $540 and set at the session. A free consult comes first. The $100 drawing fee is the deposit, counted toward the price.

services.name: Flash tattoo
services.story: A $140 flash tattoo from the studio's flash wall. A $40 deposit now, the $100 rest at the desk.

services.name: Lobe piercing
services.story: A $35 lobe piercing for an adult. Nothing is taken: a YES books it. Alex pays at the desk.

services.name: Free consult
services.story: A free 30-minute consult with Theo. Nothing is taken, and nothing is paid after.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Dante and Kira (artists in the mobile studio)

services.name: Custom piece in the mobile studio
services.story: The main story: a custom forearm piece in the mobile studio, priced by Dante from Alex's photos at $640 and OK'd by Sam. A $160 deposit now, the $480 rest on the bill Rosie texts.

services.name: Small flash in the mobile studio
services.story: A $150 small flash piece from the mobile studio's list. A $40 deposit now, the rest on the bill Rosie texts.

services.name: Cover-up in the mobile studio
services.story: A cover-up of an old tattoo, priced at the visit once Dante sees it. The $89 trip fee is paid up front as the deposit, counted toward the bill.

services_shape: sessions booked with a chosen artist; a custom piece's length is set by its design, a big piece runs over several sessions
questions_before_times: where on the body, and about how big
the style: flash from the wall, or custom
a cover-up of an old tattoo, or new skin
for a big piece: a consult first
safety_stop: trouble breathing, or a swollen face, lips or throat after a tattoo or piercing
a high fever, or red streaks spreading from a new tattoo or piercing
license: always: tattooing and body piercing are licensed where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state form)
staff_skills: custom work, flash, lettering, cover-ups, piercing; only the artist who drew a custom piece is offered for it
messages_never: health answers, health questions, healing photos, reference images and ID details never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the customer's record; the artist answers health questions in their own words on the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
